description: The posts a search found, newest first, each with post, author, classification (relevance 0 to 100, sentiment, intents, note; null while it waits for the classifier), relevant, and alreadyInWorkspace (the post is already one of your mentions). minRelevance keeps the scored results at or above it; limit (default 50) and cursor page. Readable while the search runs.

minRelevance.description: Only results scored at least this relevant (0 to 100); unscored results are left out when set.
